description: This Java source file defines an Android ViewModel class (AppListViewModel) that manages and provides a live-updating list of installed applications for an Android launcher app, along with support classes for loading app data asynchronously and handling package change broadcasts.

classes.name: AppListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that maintains a live list of launchable applications for display in the launcher.

classes.name: AppListLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that asynchronously loads and holds the list of installed launchable apps.

classes.name: PackageIntentReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for package-related system broadcasts to update the app list when apps are added, removed, or changed.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches the list of installed launchable applications asynchronously and updates the LiveData.

methods.name: getAppList
methods.description: Returns the LiveData object containing the list of apps.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver when the ViewModel is cleared.
